summary: Frontend-only verification of sticky category nav 'fits screen' fix (md:flex-1 + md:flex-wrap + md:justify-between) plus scrollspy/Tacos builder regression. All 7 requested features PASS. Preview backend API returns 200 with 40 menu items and 9 categories. Sticky nav is edge-to-edge (0px gap) on desktop 1440 and tablet 900, horizontally scrollable on mobile 375. Scrollspy activates cat-wraps both via chip click and via manual scroll. Tacos Builder card is the first grid child of section-signatures and opens the 'TACOS SUR MESURE' modal on click (visually confirmed via screenshot). No cat-all / cat-burgers chips present.

test_results.desktop_1440_fits: PASS — firstLeftGap=0px, lastRightGap=0px, flex-wrap:wrap, all 9 chips
test_results.mobile_375_scrolls: PASS — overflow-x:auto, scrollWidth=948 > clientWidth=351, flex-wrap:nowrap, all 9 chips
test_results.all_9_chips_present: PASS — cat-signatures, cat-classiques, cat-smash-burgers, cat-wraps, cat-sandwiches, cat-sides, cat-kids, cat-desserts, cat-drinks
test_results.scrollspy: PASS — cat-wraps.active=true after chip click AND after window.scrollTo to section-wraps
test_results.regression_tacos_and_no_forbidden: PASS — Tacos card is first child of section-signatures grid, opens TACOS SUR MESURE builder modal on click; no cat-all / cat-burgers chips

action_items: Production deploy issue (https://www.burgertimes.fr returns 000/500 on /api/menu) is out-of-scope for code — user must redeploy and verify production env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS). No code change possible.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu.jsx line 122: consider adding data-testid on the flex chip strip element itself (currently menu-cat-nav is on the outer sticky wrapper, forcing measurement via parentElement of a chip). Minor test ergonomics improvement.
Sections use data-testid=section-{slug} but no id — scrollIntoView by id won't work; only IntersectionObserver via ref works. Not a bug, just a test consideration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sticky nav fix verified at 1440/900/375 viewports. Measurements taken from the flex chip strip (chip0.parentElement), NOT the max-w-7xl wrapper — the max-w-7xl adds 32px padding (lg:px-8) which is expected chrome, not wasted space. Scrollspy works both via chip click and manual scroll. Tacos builder modal verified visually — its dialog element does not use [role='dialog'], use visible text 'TACOS SUR MESURE' to detect it in future tests.
